title: HBCD Genomic Release Pipeline
description: Comprehensive pipeline for de-identification, filtering, and validation of genomic data for the HEALthy Brain and Child Development (HBCD) Study data releases. Transforms raw genomic data (PLINK format, imputed VCFs, CNV calls) into release-ready derivatives that comply with HBCD data standards and participant privacy requirements.

funding_references.award_title: HEALthy Brain and Child Development Study
